arStrings.szText: Welcome to Season 14! Dark rituals are creating multiple {c_highlight}Ruptures{/c} throughout Sanctuary.

{c_highlight}Ruptures{/c} can appear all throughout Sanctuary, but are more frequent in {icon:Marker_Helltide, 2.5} Helltide Zones. Earn rewards the longer the {c_highlight}Ruptures{/c} are interrupted!
Closing {c_highlight}Ruptures{/c} will earn you {c_highlight}Glints of Hope{/c} which can be redeemed at the reputation board for rewards.
Use {c_highlight}Pandemonium Fragments{/c} gained from the Reputation Board and by defeating the Seasonal Lair Boss to craft {c_mythic}Mythic Unique{/c} items in the Horadric Cube.
Use {hotkey:Season} {c_highlight}Season Ranks{/c} to earn {c_highlight}additional rewards{/c} and uncover your next challenge.
